tidy.conflictExplain: The two documents say different things about the same fact. Correct the wrong one, then mark this reviewed; if one is out of date, you can disable it instead.
tidy.conflictsHint: Uses the selected model to extract and compare facts, only for passages that another document also covers; a single document makes no model calls. Consumes billable tokens. When off, Tidy compares only text and the existing embeddings, with no model calls.
tidy.consentConflicts: Also detect factual conflicts (consumes billable tokens)
tidy.copiesExplain: These {{count}} documents are identical. Keep one and disable the rest; you can undo this later.
tidy.description: Find duplicate documents, overlapping text, and possible factual conflicts.
tidy.disableNotice: This disables the entire selected document for retrieval, including Deep. The original is preserved, and you can undo this action if the document has not changed.
tidy.empty: No results on this page. Check scan progress and the next page, if available.
tidy.error: Unable to complete this action. Refresh and try again.
tidy.failedCount: {{count}} documents could not be scanned. Use Retry in scan progress.
tidy.freeNotice: Tidy will compare text and the embeddings already created during indexing to find duplicate, overlapping, and reworded content. This makes no model calls and incurs no charges.
tidy.mergeDescription: The other documents stop appearing in retrieval, including Deep. Their originals are preserved, and you can undo this as long as they have not changed.
tidy.pausedAuthorization: Scanning is paused because its authorization expired. Retry to authorize it again.
tidy.pausedModel: Scanning is paused because the selected model is unavailable. Check the model settings, or turn off factual conflict detection.
tidy.pausedScan: Scanning hit an error and will retry automatically.
tidy.reviewNotice: Suggestions require review. No findings does not prove there are no conflicts. Original documents are never changed automatically.
tidy.schedule: Scans published documents when enabled, then checks for new versions about every 5 minutes. Document processing and retrieval remain available.
tidy.sectionConflict: Conflict · Different answers to the same thing
tidy.sectionDuplicate: Duplicate · Copies of the same file
tidy.sectionDuplicateHint: Content is identical · safe to merge
tidy.semanticReason: These passages say the same thing in different words, possibly a rewrite or translation. Review both sources before taking action.
tidy.similarReason: These passages have substantial textual overlap. Review both sources before taking action.
tidy.stale: The evidence or document changed. Refresh and review the current version.
tidy.tokenNotice: Conflict detection uses the selected model to extract and compare facts only where different documents cover the same thing, so the number of calls depends on how much your documents overlap. It consumes billable tokens. Turning it off stops new work; a model request already running may still incur charges.
